title: Reversibly tuning thermopower enabled by phase-change electrolytes for low-grade heat harvesting
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03351E, Paper
Yinghong Xu, Zhiwei Li, Simin Li, Shengliang Zhang, Xiaogang Zhang
A reversibly tunable ionic thermoelectric generator, switching between p-type and n-type functionalities, is developed using a moderate phase-change electrolyte, which demonstrates promising potential for harvesting low-grade heat into electricity.
